steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and weigh the biological samples using a glass cover.

substeps.instruction: Take samples of the gastrointestinal tract (GIT)/biofilm and gill tissues.
Weigh out 1-2 g of the tissues.

steps.title: Digest Tissues with KOH
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue samples using a potassium hydroxide solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL of 10% KOH (maintaining a guideline ratio of 1:50 tissue to KOH).

steps.title: Set Up Filtration System
steps.instruction: Prepare the vacuum filtration apparatus to prevent sample loss.

substeps.instruction: Set up a filtration system using a Whatman 1 filter and a flask.
Soak the Whatman 1 filter in distilled water to prevent it from floating.
Ensure the vacuum is used to prevent samples from being compromised due to floating.

steps.title: Filter and Wash Samples
steps.instruction: Filter the digested solution and perform initial cleaning steps.

substeps.instruction: Pour the KOH and tissue solution into the Whatman 1 filter and apply vacuum.

steps.title: Acetone Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the filtered sample with acetone to remove organic residues.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 10 min with 10 mL acetone.
Wash with another 10 mL of acetone.

steps.title: Stain and Incubate
steps.instruction: Apply Nile Red stain and incubate the sample to highlight microplastics.

substeps.instruction: Stain with 1 mL of diluted Nile Red.
Cut the sample with forceps to increase surface area.

steps.title: Final Rinse and Recovery
steps.instruction: Clean the filter and transfer the sample for observation.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the sides of the filter with distilled water.
Rinse with 10 mL of water (washing the sides of the filter).
Carefully take the filter with forceps and place it into a glass plate.

steps.title: Observation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for microscopic analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place the sample into a Petri plate.
